title: 01. Wee-oo, Wee-oo! The Fire Engine
reviewMethod: English read-aloud translation compared with every original Korean page

pages.text: Wee-oo, wee-oo! A big red vehicle races past with flashing lights. Hori's ears perk up. Wow! What's that red fire engine? Wee-oo, wee-oo! The fire engine is on its way!
Dad, how does that vehicle put out fires? Hori asks, bouncing while holding Dad's hand. Dad smiles. If you're curious, shall we visit the place where fire engines live? Toto can come, too!
The big fire station doors slide open. Inside stands a red fire engine. Hello! Have you come to learn about fire engines? A firefighter in red gear waves. Hori's heart goes thump, thump!

The wee-oo sound comes from this siren. It tells people to make way quickly. Red warning lights spin and flash on the roof so people can see the engine from far away. Toto reaches out, and the firefighter smiles. Let's look first, Toto!

Water helps us put out fires. The fire engine carries a large tank full of water. The firefighter opens a side door and reveals a long, coiled hose. We can spray water a long way through this hose. Hori's mouth falls open.

What if a tall building catches fire? asks Hori. The firefighter points to another truck beside them. That's a ladder truck. The folded ladder on its roof stretches high into the air to help people up above. As the ladder rises with a whir, everyone says, Wow!

Would Hori like to try being a firefighter? The red gear is heavy, and the yellow helmet is big. Toto puts one on too quickly, and it slips over those eyes. I can't see! Everyone laughs. Hori settles his helmet firmly and stands proudly.

Now it's time to spray real water! Hori and the firefighter hold the hose together. Whoosh! Water shoots out like a rainbow! Hori's tail stripes sparkle in rainbow colors. I can help put out fires, too! Wee-oo, wee-oo! The fire engine is on its way!

Then, ring, ring! An emergency call comes in. The firefighters put on their gear and climb aboard. Wee-oo, wee-oo! The big doors open, and the engine races out. Hori and Toto wave. Good luck putting out the fire!

On the way home, Hori holds Dad's hand and chats. The siren warns people, water from the tank sprays through the hose, and the ladder reaches high up! Firefighters keep us safe by putting out fires. Hori smiles up at the sky. Wee-oo, wee-oo! The fire engine is on its way!
